info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 08 - Education & Work

words.pinyin: Jīntiān de jiǎngzuò hěn yǒu bāngzhù

words.en: We discussed it in the seminar
words.zh: 我们在研讨会上讨论过。
words.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yántǎohuì shàng tǎolùn guò

words.zh: 加入我们的学习小组吧。
words.pinyin: Jiārù wǒmen de xuéxí xiǎozǔ ba

words.en: I need to update my notes
Can we get a deadline extension?
Could you share the slides after class?
I'm catching up on last week's lecture
words.pinyin: Wǒ zài bǔ shàngzhōu de jiǎngzuò

words.en: Can we form a study pair for the exam?
words.zh: 我们可以结对复习考试吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ jiéduì fùxí kǎoshì ma?

words.en: I'll email the professor with our questions
words.zh: 我会给教授发邮件问我们的问题。
words.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi jiàoshòu fā yóujiàn wèn wǒmen de wèntí
Nín shì zuò shénme gōngzuò de?
Wǒ zhèngzài zuò yí gè xiàngmù
Nín néng pīzhǔn zhège rènwu ma?

words.zh: 我们回顾一下会议议程。
这次培训能培养新技能。
words.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn néng péiyǎng xīn jìnéng

words.en: Let's align on priorities before the meeting
words.zh: 会议前我们先统一优先级。
words.pinyin: Huìyì qián wǒmen xiān tǒngyī yōuxiānjí

words.en: Can you cover my shift on Friday afternoon?
words.zh: 周五下午您能帮我顶班吗？
words.pinyin: Zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ nín néng bāng wǒ dǐngbān ma?

words.en: I'll send a recap after the call
words.pinyin: Tōnghuà hòu wǒ huì fā gè zǒngjié

words.en: Could you loop me in on that thread?
words.zh: 能把我也加进那个讨论吗？
words.pinyin: Néng bǎ wǒ yě jiā jìn nàge tǎolùn ma?

words.zh: 我需要我的笔记本电脑。
words.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào wǒ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo

words.zh: 我可以用您的平板电脑吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng nín de píngbǎn diànnǎo ma?

words.zh: 我可以用您的充电器吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng nín de chōngdiànqì ma?

words.en: I'll upload it to cloud storage
words.zh: 我会把它上传到云存储。
words.pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ tā shàngchuán dào yún cúnchǔ

words.zh: 打开一个新的浏览器标签页。
words.pinyin: Dǎkāi yí gè xīn de liúlǎnqì biāoqiānyè

words.en: Could you mute when you're not speaking?
words.pinyin: Bù shuōhuà shí néng jìngyīn ma?

words.en: Let's test the microphone before we start
words.zh: 开始前我们测试一下麦克风。
words.pinyin: Kāishǐ qián wǒmen cèshì yíxià màikèfēng

words.en: I'll share the link in the chat
words.zh: 我会在聊天中分享链接。
words.pinyin: Wǒ huì zài liáotiān zhōng fēnxiǎng liànjiē

words.en: Please back up the file to cloud storage
words.zh: 请把文件备份到云存储。
words.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn bèifèn dào yún cúnchǔ
